scope: Previously exposed G1/G2 only; no R1 I/C/S or official benchmark test files; no new GPU execution or git changes.
hypothesis: Some observed graph contexts have edge interactions for which apparently negligible single-edge deletion losses coexist with a positive joint deletion loss; the signal may instead be seed noise.
data_inventory_first: Enumerate all recorded same-question graph masks by protocol/model lineage and seed. A 2x2 face requires both tested edges vary and every other bit is identical. Never impute an unexecuted corner. Different questions, seeds, models or backgrounds cannot complete a face.
frozen_input_pin: Existing accepted G2 D2 private inputs.npz SHA256 7639dad2581ea52536b7c274d33fd019ad726a9bce9e8e4ec6792c68b77f4963; original G2 frozen_plan SHA256 90cbbe0e22ae1cad177e30706759a6e04341ca1a956f8faf62f80497360cdeb2.
enumeration: All unordered edge pairs, all recorded backgrounds with those two bits cleared, all questions. Deduplicate each question/pair/background; observed F00,F01,F10,F11 in binary edge order. Count missing corners and complete faces before quality access.
outcome: Historical binary answer quality; no cost penalty added retrospectively. Edges present=1, absent=0.

definitions.a: F11-F01: loss of deleting first edge when both present
definitions.b: F11-F10: loss of deleting second edge when both present
definitions.L: F11-F00: joint deletion loss; equal to joint restoration gain from F00
definitions.redundancy_signature: a=b=0,L>0 implies h<0. This identity is not proof that empirical zero singles have zero conditional means.
definitions.de_noised_square: For K complete independent-seed replicates, ((sum_s h_s)^2-sum_s h_s^2)/(K*(K-1)); estimates squared conditional mean only under conditional independent identically distributed seed replicates. Retain negative values.
definitions.single_de_noised_squares: Apply same cross-seed product estimator to a and b; negative estimates retained.
definitions.same_seed_square: mean(h_s^2), descriptive and noise-confounded; not substitute for cross-seed square.

seed_design.near_zero_selection: On selection seeds only, abs(mean(a))<=0.05 and abs(mean(b))<=0.05; fixed threshold, no pair or graph selection by joint outcomes.
seed_design.evaluation: Report heldout L,a,b,h on every selected face/fold; average folds within face where selected, faces within question, then questions equally. Both folds are dependent and never two independent replications.
seed_design.selection_denominator: Report eligible questions/faces, selected fold-face counts, selected distinct questions, and per-fold selected counts. No selected cells gives INCONCLUSIVE, never zero effect.
seed_design.independence_boundary: Historical per-node seed derivation/fork_rng and no collisions are engineering support, not mathematical independence proof; common questions/backgrounds induce clustering.

statistics.unit: Question; all faces/edge pairs and both crossfit folds stay in the same cluster
statistics.weight: Equal question weights; within each question equal complete-face weights for unconditional summaries, equal selected-face weights for selection summaries
statistics.intervals: percentile 95%; 90% for explicitly exploratory single-effect equivalence screen; no validated coverage claim for small supports
statistics.partition_reporting: G2 train200/tune80/exposed-development120 individually and all400 pooled; all are previously exposed development evidence, no independent confirmation
statistics.pair_reporting: Every represented pair with denominator, no best-pair selection
statistics.primary_scope: All complete 5-seed G2 faces; G1 separated by lineage/available seed design, never pooled as iid replicates

all_signal_conditions_required: cross-seed interaction square point>0 and question-bootstrap95 lower>0
crossfit joint deletion loss point>=0.10 and question-bootstrap95 lower>0
both crossfit heldout single-loss 90% intervals entirely within [-0.05,0.05]
low_cost_investment_screen.interpretation: Only evidence to consider a bounded fresh pilot for this observed-context phenomenon, not approval, algorithm novelty, online improvement, or equal-full-cost superiority.
low_cost_investment_screen.failure: Missing four worlds => NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; insufficient support or intervals spanning thresholds => INCONCLUSIVE; valid opposite effect or no detectable interaction => NO_SUPPORTED_SIGNAL_FOR_THIS_CANDIDATE. Preserve all outcomes; never stop the overall project solely for this route.

fairness_contract.action_space: Candidate, uniform group-feedback, fixed cyclic group-feedback, greedy group lookahead, and rollback baseline all receive same predeclared singleton/pair deletions/restorations and stay; same initial bank.
fairness_contract.strong_baselines: Direct fresh joint verification and limited-depth pair lookahead, plus same-action-space uniform/cyclic feedback. A single-edge-only control isolates action-space benefit but is not the decisive maintenance baseline.
fairness_contract.shared_cache: Every method shares identical exact execution-cache semantics, valid only at same question/seed/model/full state. Prefix probes, speculative calls and rollback are charged.
fairness_contract.full_cost: Initialization + pair/single feedback + any failed proposals/rollback + scoring + independent future service; physical shared collection and logical deployment ledgers both retained.
fairness_contract.historical_limit: Four-world historical quality identifies local outcome interactions only. Without a full logged intervention/rollback/feedback policy trajectory, it cannot identify active acquisition value or future-service benefit.
